derived_from: SKILL.md § <NON-NEGOTIABLE> Task citation integrity is textual — do not judge it
prompt: A task cites requirement SHELL-1.2, but reading it you think the task really implements SHELL-1.3.
assertions: the citation is checked textually against the defined IDs rather than judged on intent
no re-interpretation of what the task 'really' implements is substituted for the text
the pass reports what the sets say

prompt: Run the traceability audit for this feature.
assertions: the passes run over the docs spine rather than over application source or tests
results are reported as set differences: unknown citations, duplicate definitions, uncited approved requirements
